answer: Attention-Debt Registry. Each identity must maintain a rolling window of verified micro-interactions whose spacing matches human refractory limits; idle gaps accrue debt. Crossing the juniper threshold forces re-verification via fresh tasks. Sybils pay the nadir cost: parallel identities each need distinct sustained attention streams, so N fakes cost N full-time task budgets. Operators can't batch because debt is per-stream, on shale-like staggered schedules. Enforcement is mechanical: debt above limit freezes the identity until cleared.
